ceo.name: Adam Foroughi
ceo.background: Co-Founder & CEO since December 2011, Chairperson since March 2021. Born in Los Angeles in 1980 after family fled Iraq-Iran War. UC Berkeley economics graduate. Previous entrepreneur with two marketing-tech companies (Lifestreet Media and Social Hour). Former derivatives trader inspired by high-frequency data-driven models.
ceo.track_record: Led AppLovin from startup to $4.7B revenue company (2024). Spearheaded key acquisitions including MoPub ($1.05B from Twitter) and Machine Zone (MZ). Successfully took company public in 2021. 2024 results: $4.7B revenue (+43% YoY), $1.6B GAAP net income (34% margin), $2.7B Adjusted EBITDA (58% margin).
ceo.recognition: Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the Year Award 2018. Net worth estimated at $2B.

cfo.name: Herald Chen
cfo.background: Dual degree in engineering and finance from University of Pennsylvania Management & Technology program. Stanford MBA. Former head of KKR's Technology, Media and Telecom investing (2007-2019). Previously Managing Director at Fox Paine & Company, CEO of ACMI Corporation, CFO and co-founder of Jamcracker Inc.
cfo.track_record: Guided AppLovin through successful IPO in April 2021. During his tenure as CFO, helped increase revenue nearly sevenfold to $3.3B and net income to $357M in 2023.

key_executives.name: Victoria Valenzuela
key_executives.title: Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
